description.value: Watermania is a municipal aquatic and recreation centre operated by the City of Richmond, offering swimming, yoga, and fitness activities. Located on Entertainment Boulevard, it is one of several public recreation facilities in Richmond's park system. A touring cyclist could potentially use it as a drop-in stop for swimming or freshening up.

OSM tags confirm it is a government-operated sports centre offering swimming, yoga, and fitness, with a fee for entry. While a municipal aquatic centre almost certainly has washrooms and showers, the scraped website text does not explicitly describe any facility amenities, bike parking, or water refill options, so these must remain null. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned in any source.
